date_published.why: 2024-01-31 is the Nationalrat's adoption date; the Bundesrat declined to object on 15 February 2024 and the gazette date is not in a stored file. Defensible as the adoption date.

date_in_force.why: Both commencement clauses (§ 44 Abs. 36 KOG, § 217 Abs. 3 TKG 2021) say 'treten mit 1. Jänner 2024 in Kraft'. The stored text is the Nationalrat's adopted text with a placeholder gazette number (BGBl. I Nr. xxx/2023); the promulgated text in RIS is not stored.

summary_claims.claim: RTR-GmbH builds and runs a Service Centre for AI (KI-Servicestelle). Literal translation of § 17 Abs. 8 KOG: 'Under the joint responsibility of both managing directors, RTR-GmbH has the task of building and running a service centre for artificial intelligence.'
Eleven-member AI Advisory Board at RTR advising on technical, ethical and societal aspects of AI

note: Parliament pages, the committee report 2419 d.B. and the adopted text confirm the title, 3821/A, adoption on 31 January 2024, the Bundesrat decision of 15 February 2024 and the 1 January 2024 start. BGBl. I Nr. 6/2024 is named on the parliament page but the RIS copy could not be stored, so the issue date is unconfirmed; the run removed v1's unsupported 26 February 2024. A search found no Austrian AI Act implementing law, matching the notes' account (question 5638/J and answer 5062/AB of 2 June 2026).
